admission.justification: A dispatcher and its joined workers must agree on owner lifetime or a worker can retain and use stale request data.

applicability: Request-owned computation under native MCP dispatch.
conditions: Workers joined by the invocation retain its scope until they exit.
A copied worker context shares the same keyed owners until scope exit.
exclusions: Detached quality computations own separate scopes.
Process-shared, explicitly bounded memos have separate owners.

evidence: The request-owner lifecycle test and native dispatch success, refusal, error, and cancellation proofs.
handoff.path: BUG-L18 W2 affected knowledge and initial history

statement: A tool invocation releases its request-owned computation state when it completes, including on refusal, error, or cancellation.
